rationale: The Evaluator feedback suggests that the current candidate has not yet been tested in a race, so we lack telemetry to confirm the effects of previous changes. The feedback recommends slightly lowering base_speed to 1.45 or 1.5 to improve stability and reduce line loss events, adjusting sensor_weights to [-1.0, -0.6, 0, 0.6, 1.0] to reduce oversteering and oscillations, and keeping kp at 6 or 7 to balance responsiveness and stability. I have implemented these changes by increasing base_speed to 1.5 to maximize speed while maintaining stability, setting sensor_weights to [-1.0, -0.6, 0, 0.6, 1.0] to reduce the influence of outer sensors and smooth steering, and setting kp to 7 to reduce overshoot and oscillations. I keep ki at 0.35 and kd at 3 to maintain integral correction and damping. The geometry remains unchanged as no issues were reported. I request telemetry on completion, progress, line_loss_events, rms_error, and steering_oscillation to evaluate if these changes improve speed, stability, and line tracking as expected.
